title: Raccoon holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe9a8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffd166'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='24' ry='18' fill='#8d99ae'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='14' ry='11' fill='#c8d1e0'/>
  <!-- arms holding heart -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='66' rx='7' ry='9' fill='#6c7a93' transform='rotate(-25 35 66)'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='66' rx='7' ry='9' fill='#6c7a93' transform='rotate(25 65 66)'/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='60' r='5' fill='#3f4a60'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='60' r='5' fill='#3f4a60'/>
  <!-- heart -->
  <path d='M50 58 C47 52, 40 52, 40 57 C40 61, 46 65, 50 69 C54 65, 60 61, 60 57 C60 52, 53 52, 50 58 Z' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <path d='M46 57 C45 55, 42 55, 42 57 C42 58.5, 44 60, 46 61.5' fill='none' stroke='#ffb3c1' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='20' fill='#8d99ae'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='25' r='7' fill='#6c7a93'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='25' r='7' fill='#6c7a93'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='25' r='3.5' fill='#c8d1e0'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='25' r='3.5' fill='#c8d1e0'/>
  <!-- mask -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='38' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#3f4a60'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='38' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#3f4a60'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='38' r='3.5' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='38' r='3.5' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='37' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='37' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='49' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#e6ecf5'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='46' r='3' fill='#3f4a60'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M46 51 Q50 55 54 51' fill='none' stroke='#3f4a60' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='48' r='3' fill='#ffb3c1' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='48' r='3' fill='#ffb3c1' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <ellipse cx='82' cy='82' rx='10' ry='6' fill='#6c7a93' transform='rotate(-30 82 82)'/>
  <ellipse cx='87' cy='86' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#c8d1e0' transform='rotate(-30 87 86)'/>
</svg>
